acquisition_policy.boss: encounter-specific motif and focal treatment; specificity, not automatic glow, carries status
acquisition_policy.crafted: deliberate construction, clean joins and profession-specific functional detailing
acquisition_policy.prestige: rare silhouette/treatment with disciplined status cues and Minecraft-readable massing
acquisition_policy.world: environment-derived surfaces, practical repairs and exposure-led weathering

CLOTH.palette_policy: textile value blocks dominate; metallic or crystal colour is a small seam/focal accent
CLOTH.silhouette: light vertical flow, hood/veil framing, layered hems and narrow rigid edges

LEATHER.palette_policy: hide ramps and treatment stains dominate; metal is limited to buckles or small reinforcement
LEATHER.silhouette: mobile fitted mass with diagonal panels, straps and organic reinforcement

MAIL.palette_policy: metal rhythm is broken by visible backing and joins; never read as a solid recoloured plate
MAIL.silhouette: medium mass between leather and plate with visible backing and repeated ring/scale rhythm

PLATE.palette_policy: large metal value blocks dominate while undersuit and inset separate articulation
PLATE.silhouette: heavy geometric mass with framed forged panels, broad hard edges and structural joints

global_policy.animation_policy: No armor animation in RP2-B pilot. Future animation needs an explicit client-safe pipeline decision.
global_policy.asymmetry_policy: One purposeful asymmetry is allowed for straps, patches or trophies; core slot readability remains balanced.
global_policy.boss_prestige_escalation: Reserve silhouette exceptions, emissive level 3, rare material treatments and encounter-specific motifs for boss/prestige lines.
global_policy.colorblind_value_policy: No line is distinguished by hue alone; silhouette tag, construction rhythm and value structure are independently meaningful.
global_policy.magical_effect_policy: Magic is embedded in seam, ring, inset or etching structure. No generic aura and no all-over neon.
global_policy.material_readability: Construction rhythm comes before hue: weave, hide panel, ring/scale repetition and plate framing are mandatory family signals.
global_policy.ornament_density: early=low, mid=restrained, high=confident, endgame=specific; never fill every surface.
global_policy.outline_usage: Use selective dark material boundaries, not a universal black contour around every UV island.
global_policy.palette_discipline: One dominant material ramp, one secondary ramp and one accent per line; family identity never depends on a fixed family colour.
global_policy.pixel_density_philosophy: Author inventory art on a 32x logical grid and nearest-neighbour upscale to 64x; worn art keeps the fixed 1.21.11 64x32 UV coordinate grid at 2x texture sampling (128x64).
global_policy.saturation: Most surfaces stay low-to-medium saturation; one controlled line accent may be saturated.
global_policy.shading_philosophy: Four-to-six authored value steps, hard pixel clusters, no smooth PBR gradients or single-pixel confetti noise.
global_policy.silhouette_complexity: Increase by refined layering and focal geometry, not by universal spikes or oversized shoulders.
global_policy.value_contrast: Family construction must remain readable in grayscale; reserve the brightest value for material edges or one focal motif.
global_policy.weathering_policy: Crafted joins are clean; wilderness wear follows exposed edges; boss/prestige finish may be unusual but never uniformly glossy.

profession_policy.alchemist: infused/tinctured surfaces, resin joins and visibly transformed organic material
profession_policy.armorer: structural reinforcement, rivets, rings, framed joins and serviceable geometry
profession_policy.enchanter: runes integrated into seams, conductive paths and restrained arcane focal points

progression_policy.early: few materials, direct construction and broad readable blocks
progression_policy.endgame: specific material finish and refined silhouette; preserve sidegrade parity and avoid universal gold/glow escalation
progression_policy.high: sophisticated joins, confident motif integration and more deliberate contrast
progression_policy.mid: one secondary material, cleaner fit and a controlled identifying motif
